title: Keep leak check out of canonical Markdown bodies
decision: The SG-0007 source-leak check should not scan canonical Markdown document bodies under workspaces/epp-full/content. It should focus on app-facing workspace metadata, manifests, project metadata, and service-response inputs.
context: Canonical Markdown is retained app content and SG-0007 explicitly does not rewrite canonical document content during import. Some canonical documents may mention historical worksheet or source file names as part of their content.
rationale: Keeping the leak check out of canonical Markdown prevents an import-retention cleanup from becoming a content-review or rewriting task. Mentions inside retained documents can be handled by later content review if needed.
alternatives_considered: Scan canonical Markdown bodies and fail on original-source filename mentions
Rewrite canonical Markdown content during import to remove source-like mentions
consequences: SG-0007 remains an import and metadata cleanup slice
Canonical Markdown content remains unchanged during import
Historical file-name mentions inside retained documents are not treated as SG-0007 failures
Future content-review work may address document-body mentions if they become user-facing problems
